title: Reducing Feed Wastage and Stress in Catfish Farming

detail.title: Reducing Feed Wastage and Stress in Catfish Farming
detail.abstract: In catfish farming, feed is both the engine and the expense. It fuels growth, determines harvest size, and quietly decides whether a farm ends the season profitable or struggling. At the same time, feed is where most wastage occurs and where stress, often invisible, begins to take root in fish populations. Pellets sink uneaten, water quality degrades, fish compete aggressively, and farmers respond by adding more feed, hoping to compensate. The cycle repeats, slowly eroding margins and animal welfare at once. What makes this problem particularly complex is that feed wastage and fish stress are not separate issues. They are deeply entangled. Poor feeding practices increase stress, and stressed fish convert feed less efficiently, leading to even more waste². For small and medium scale catfish farmers, especially in regions where aquaculture is both a livelihood and a food security strategy, this feedback loop can be devastating. This article explores how feed wastage and stress emerge in catfish farming, why traditional solutions often fall short, and how integrated, data informed, and biologically sensitive practices can reduce losses while improving fish welfare. The future of sustainable catfish farming will depend not on feeding more, but on feeding smarter.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨鲶鱼养殖中饲料浪费与鱼类应激的相互关联问题，分析传统解决方案的不足，提出基于数据、整合生物学敏感性的智能饲喂实践，旨在同时减少损失并改善鱼类福利。
AI.research_question: 鲶鱼养殖中饲料浪费与鱼类应激如何相互关联并形成恶性循环？传统解决方案为何失效？如何通过整合数据驱动和生物学敏感的饲喂实践来同时减少损失并改善鱼类福利？
AI.motivation: 饲料是鲶鱼养殖的主要成本和增长引擎，但也是浪费最严重、应激产生的根源。传统饲喂实践导致饲料沉底未被摄食、水质恶化、鱼类竞争加剧，形成饲料浪费与应激的恶性循环，严重侵蚀养殖利润和动物福利，对中小规模养殖户的生计和粮食安全策略造成威胁。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 饲料浪费与鱼类应激的相互关联理论：不良饲喂实践增加应激，应激鱼类饲料转化效率降低导致更多浪费，形成正反馈循环。2. 可持续水产养殖理论：强调环境、经济和社会可持续性的平衡。3. 动物福利理论：关注鱼类应激和福利指标。
AI.method: 本文采用理论分析和综合评述方法，通过文献回顾和案例分析，探讨饲料浪费与应激的关联机制，评估传统解决方案的局限性，提出整合性实践框架。
AI.findings: 1. 饲料浪费与鱼类应激是深度交织的问题，而非独立现象。2. 传统解决方案（如增加投喂量）往往加剧问题而非解决。3. 整合数据驱动和生物学敏感的饲喂实践能同时减少损失并改善福利。4. 可持续鲶鱼养殖的未来在于"智能饲喂"而非"更多饲喂"。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出饲料浪费与鱼类应激的相互关联理论框架，阐明其正反馈循环机制。2. 发展整合性可持续水产养殖理论，强调数据驱动和生物学敏感性的重要性。3. 丰富动物福利理论在水产养殖中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为中小规模鲶鱼养殖户提供减少饲料浪费和改善鱼类福利的实用指南。2. 提出数据驱动的智能饲喂实践框架。3. 为政策制定者提供促进可持续水产养殖的策略建议。4. 为饲料制造商和养殖设备供应商提供产品开发方向。

title:
Access and Utilization of Biomass as Fuel Energy by Rural

Households in Nkanu West Local Government Area of Enugu State
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title:
Access and Utilization of Biomass as Fuel Energy by Rural

Households in Nkanu West Local Government Area of Enugu State
detail.abstract: Biomass is the most basic energy source especially in poor households and in rural areas, particularly subsistence farmers living in rural areas in developing countries often lack adequate access to basic infrastructure, electricity and modern fuels. This study therefore explores the access and utilization of biomass as fuel energy by rural households in Nkanu West local government of Enugu State. The specific objectives were to examine the Socio-economic characteristics of rural household, identify the various sources and access to biomass by rural households, investigate the constraints to access of biomass, identify different uses and the level of utilization of biomass and make recommendations based on the findings of this study. Population for the study was rural households and simple random sampling technique was employed in selecting six towns from the study area which include Amodu, Agbani, Ammuri, Ozalla, Obe, and Umueze, Ten household were randomly selected from the six selected towns. Data was collected from primary sources by the use of well-structured and validated questionnaires and a face to face interview. The data was analyzed using descriptive statistics which largely involves the use of frequencies, percentages, and 4 point likert type scale mean rating. Results show that about 75% of the respondents are female, the mean age is 46.03, about 66.7% were married, and an average educational level. In addition 45% of respondents were traders; the mean household size is 5.27, the mean number of years spent in the community by the respondents is 24.52 and the mean income is Nl41000 indicating that majority of the respondents earn an average income per month. The study also shows that the biomass used in the study area includes fuel, charcoal and crop residue (palm fronds, palm kernel seeds and chaff). Households acquire their biomass by collecting and purchasing their biomass from the forest, market, farm and their immediate environment, also the rated distance is on the averageIn addition, results also reveals that the rural households on the average use their biomass often for cooking only because they alternatively use other source of energy suck as kerosene, LPG (Liquefied Petroleum Gas) and electricity for heating and lighting. The research also exposes the fact that 99% of the household have access to biomass and they use it as their source of fuel energy. Although the study investigated 14 possible constraints, but none was regarded as a 'major constraint to the household access and utilization of biomass. The study among other things recommends a more comprehensive effort to ensure efficient and sustainable use of biomass source of energy by rural households so as to avoid environmental degradation.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了尼日利亚Enugu州Nkanu West地区农村家庭获取和利用生物质作为燃料能源的情况。研究发现该地区99%的家庭能够获取生物质能源，主要用于烹饪，同时也会使用煤油、液化石油气和电力等其他能源。研究未发现生物质获取和利用的主要障碍，建议促进生物质能源的高效可持续利用以避免环境退化。
AI.research_question: 农村家庭如何获取和利用生物质作为燃料能源？具体包括：农村家庭的社会经济特征、生物质来源和获取途径、获取生物质的制约因素、生物质的不同用途和利用水平。
AI.motivation: 生物质是贫困家庭和农村地区最基本的能源来源，特别是在发展中国家，自给自足的农民往往缺乏足够的基础设施、电力和现代燃料。本研究旨在了解农村家庭获取和利用生物质燃料能源的现状。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本研究基于能源获取和利用理论，特别是针对农村地区的生物质能源利用模式。研究关注社会经济因素与能源获取之间的关系，以及能源使用模式与环境可持续性的联系。
AI.method: 采用描述性研究方法，从研究区域随机选取6个城镇（Amodu、Agbani、Ammuri、Ozalla、Obe、Umueze），每个城镇随机选择10户家庭。通过结构化问卷和面对面访谈收集主要数据，使用频率、百分比和4点李克特量表均值等描述性统计方法进行分析。
AI.findings: 1. 受访者主要为女性（75%），平均年龄46.03岁，66.7%已婚，平均教育水平；2. 45%为商人，平均家庭规模5.27人，平均居住时间24.52年，平均月收入Nl41000；3. 使用的生物质包括木柴、木炭和作物残留物（棕榈叶、棕榈仁籽和谷壳）；4. 家庭通过从森林、市场、农场和周边环境收集和购买获取生物质；5. 农村家庭主要将生物质用于烹饪，同时使用煤油、液化石油气和电力进行加热和照明；6. 99%的家庭能够获取生物质并用作燃料能源；7. 调查的14个可能制约因素中，没有一个被认为是"主要制约因素"。
AI.theory_contributions: 本研究为农村能源获取理论提供了实证支持，表明在特定农村环境中，生物质获取可能不是主要问题。研究结果挑战了关于农村地区生物质获取普遍存在严重障碍的假设，强调了需要更细致地理解不同农村社区的能源获取模式。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了关于Nkanu West地区农村家庭生物质能源利用的具体数据；2. 建议采取更全面的努力确保农村家庭高效和可持续地利用生物质能源；3. 强调了避免环境退化的必要性；4. 为类似农村地区的能源规划提供了参考依据。

title: National Transformational Capacity Theory and the Integrated Economic Growth Model

detail.title: National Transformational Capacity Theory and the Integrated Economic Growth Model
detail.abstract: This article presents the National Transformational Capacity (NTC) Theory as an analytical framework for understanding the middle-income trap not merely as a problem of inadequate policies or scarce resources, but as a limitation in a country’s capacity to organize and strategically coordinate development at the system level. Building on this perspective, the paper links NTC to Vietnam’s Integrated Economic Growth Model (IGM) as a concrete application aimed at simultaneously addressing three structural bottlenecks of growth: low productivity, low domestic value added, and limited access to international markets. The analysis shows that Vietnam’s pathway toward high-quality growth depends on strengthening its national transformational capacity—turning reforms into endogenous drivers of development and opening a more sustainable long-term growth trajectory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出国家转型能力理论作为分析框架，将中等收入陷阱视为国家在系统层面组织和战略协调发展的能力限制，而非仅仅是政策或资源问题。该理论应用于越南综合经济增长模型，旨在同时解决生产率低、国内附加值低和国际市场准入有限三个结构性瓶颈。
AI.research_question: 如何通过国家转型能力理论框架理解中等收入陷阱，并将其应用于越南综合经济增长模型以解决结构性增长瓶颈？
AI.motivation: 中等收入陷阱通常被归因于政策不足或资源稀缺，但本文认为这实际上是国家在系统层面组织和战略协调发展的能力限制问题，需要新的理论框架来理解这一现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国家转型能力理论，强调国家在系统层面组织和战略协调发展的能力，将中等收入陷阱视为能力限制而非政策或资源问题。
AI.method: 理论框架构建与案例应用分析，将国家转型能力理论应用于越南综合经济增长模型的具体实践。
AI.findings: 越南实现高质量增长的关键在于加强国家转型能力，将改革转化为发展的内生驱动力，从而开辟更可持续的长期增长路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了国家转型能力理论作为分析中等收入陷阱的新框架，超越了传统的政策或资源视角，强调系统层面的组织和协调能力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为越南等中等收入国家提供了具体的政策指导，通过综合经济增长模型同时解决生产率低、国内附加值低和国际市场准入有限三个结构性瓶颈。

detail.abstract: This quantitative study examines how music IP rights are transforming into a global financial asset class, which is having an impact on artists and music ecosystems worldwide. New investors and digital platforms are changing the way creative works and rights are valued and monetised across diverse cultural contexts. By providing empirical evidence of these dynamics and identifying key stakeholders via the data, the study can help inform policymakers and potential changes to IP and other legal frameworks. The research draws on new data sources and original analyses of the latest trends in news media coverage and investment in music rights technology, as well as daily return data from rights trading platforms and information from official IP data sources.

detail.title: Show-Off Culture and Financial Stress among Young Adults: A Systematic Theoretical Review

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethical approval was not required for this study as it is based on secondary data from publicly available sources and does not involve human participants or personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The author did not receive any financial support from public, commercial, or non- profit organizations for the conduct of the research.

detail.abstract: This study examines the relationship between show-off culture and financial stress among young adults through a systematic theoretical review of existing literature. In the digital age, social media platforms have amplified conspicuous consumption and social comparison, shaping perceptions of success, lifestyle, and financial adequacy. The study draws upon established theories such as Veblen's Theory of Conspicuous Consumption, Social Comparison Theory, and concepts from Behavioral Finance to understand how digitally mediated social pressures influence financial behavior. Using secondary data from peer-reviewed journals, academic databases, and authoritative institutional reports, the study synthesizes key themes related to spending pressure, lifestyle inflation, credit dependence, and financial anxiety among young adults. The findings suggest that show-off culture, reinforced by social media visibility and validation mechanisms, contributes significantly to distorted financial decision-making and increased financial stress. The study highlights important implications for personal financial management, emphasizing the need for behavioral awareness and financial literacy that address psychological and social influences on spending behavior. By integrating financial and psychological perspectives, the paper contributes to a deeper theoretical understanding of social media-driven financial stress and identifies directions for future empirical research.

title: The Price of Market Fear: A Microstructure Analysis of Peru's Presidential Crisis (2016-2026)

detail.title: The Price of Market Fear: A Microstructure Analysis of Peru's Presidential Crisis (2016-2026)
detail.abstract: This paper challenges the conventional narrative that Peru's macroeconomic stability is decoupled from its chronic political instability. Analyzing a decade characterized by unprecedented executive turnover-eight presidents in ten years-we quantify the financial cost of governance crises using high-frequency microstructure data from 2016 to 2026. We construct a Synthetic Fear Index (VIX-PE) and utilize a generalized Garman-Kohlhagen specification adapted for endogenous interest rates to isolate "Market Fear" from broader societal insecurity. Our empirical results, based on 2,486 daily observations, reveal three structural findings. First, financial markets discriminate sharply between "executive noise" and "foundational risk." OLS regressions confirm that systemic risk peaked not during the chaotic tenure of Manuel Merino (β = 0.66), but during the 2021 electoral transition under Francisco Sagasti (β = 0.90 * * *), driven by the credible threat of constitutional change. Second, a scatter plot analysis identifies a distinct "Castillo Quadrant," characterized by high volatility and low liquidity. Third, applying the GK-Taylor option pricing model reveals a "Taylor Paradox": the implied cost of currency hedging remained at historical highs even as the Central Bank aggressively raised interest rates. We conclude that while the macroeconomic model survived, political instability imposed a severe "fear tax" on liquidity, rendering monetary transmission mechanisms less effective during periods of foundational uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了秘鲁宏观经济稳定与政治动荡脱钩的传统观点，通过高频市场数据分析发现政治不稳定对金融市场造成严重"恐惧税"，削弱了货币政策传导机制的有效性。
AI.research_question: 秘鲁的政治不稳定如何影响其金融市场和宏观经济稳定性？具体而言，不同类型的政治危机（行政噪音 vs 基础性风险）对市场波动、流动性和货币政策传导有何差异影响？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为秘鲁的宏观经济稳定与政治动荡脱钩，但作者认为这种观点忽视了政治不稳定对金融市场造成的隐性成本。秘鲁在过去十年经历了八位总统的更迭，为研究政治不稳定对金融市场的影响提供了独特案例。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 政治经济学与金融市场互动理论；2. 波动率指数（VIX）理论；3. Garman-Kohlhagen外汇期权定价模型；4. 泰勒规则与货币政策传导理论；5. 市场微观结构理论
AI.method: 1. 构建合成恐惧指数（VIX-PE）；2. 使用适应内生利率的广义Garman-Kohlhagen模型分离"市场恐惧"与社会不安全感；3. 基于2,486个日度观测数据的OLS回归分析；4. 散点图分析识别"卡斯蒂略象限"；5. 应用GK-Taylor期权定价模型分析货币政策传导
AI.findings: 1. 金融市场能清晰区分"行政噪音"和"基础性风险"：系统性风险峰值出现在2021年萨加斯蒂选举过渡期（β=0.90***），而非梅里诺混乱任期（β=0.66）；2. 识别出"卡斯蒂略象限"：高波动性和低流动性并存；3. 发现"泰勒悖论"：尽管央行激进加息，货币对冲的隐含成本仍保持历史高位
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战了宏观经济与政治稳定脱钩的传统叙事；2. 提出"恐惧税"概念，量化政治不稳定对流动性的影响；3. 发展了区分"行政噪音"与"基础性风险"的分析框架；4. 揭示了政治不稳定如何削弱货币政策传导机制
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供量化政治不稳定金融成本的工具；2. 帮助投资者更好评估新兴市场的政治风险；3. 为央行在政治不稳定时期制定更有效的货币政策提供参考；4. 为国际金融机构评估秘鲁等类似国家的风险提供新视角

title: The Limits of Local Growth: Dependences and Declining Dynamics in Small Rural Municipalities in Brazil: The Case of São Pedro Do Ivaí
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Limits of Local Growth: Dependences and Declining Dynamics in Small Rural Municipalities in Brazil: The Case of São Pedro Do Ivaí

keywords: Industrial Dependence Socioeconomic Stagnation Shift-Share Paraná Brazil

detail.abstract: Small inland municipalities in Brazil have faced significant long-term challenges related to productive specialization and limited economic diversification. São Pedro do Ivaí, located in the state of Paraná, experienced accelerated expansion during the mid-20th century, driven first by the coffee economy and later by the sugarcane industry. However, external shocks, particularly the 1975 frost, and structural dependency on a single agro-industrial activity have resulted in persistent socioeconomic stagnation. This paper analyzes the economic and demographic evolution of the municipality between 1970 and 2020, drawing on sectoral structure, specialization indices, and shift-share results. The findings reveal loss of competitiveness, decline in formal employment, aging population, and continuous out-migration of young workers. The case illustrates the vulnerability of small rural economies exposed to volatile agricultural markets and lacking endogenous drivers of innovation. These dynamics reflect broader regional challenges in Brazil's hinterland, emphasizing the need for diversification strategies and long-term territorial development policies aimed at strengthening resilience in small municipalities .

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了巴西小型内陆城市São Pedro do Ivaí在1970-2020年间的经济与人口演变，揭示了其因单一农业专业化、外部冲击和缺乏创新驱动而陷入长期社会经济停滞的问题。
AI.research_question: 巴西小型内陆城市São Pedro do Ivaí在1970-2020年间经历了怎样的经济与人口演变？其长期社会经济停滞的根源是什么？
AI.motivation: 巴西小型内陆城市面临生产专业化程度高、经济多元化有限的长期挑战，São Pedro do Ivaí作为典型案例，其从咖啡经济到甘蔗产业的兴衰历程反映了单一农业依赖的脆弱性，特别是1975年霜冻等外部冲击的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 区域经济发展理论、专业化与多元化理论、经济韧性理论、人口迁移理论、农业依赖与脆弱性理论
AI.method: 采用1970-2020年的历史数据分析，运用部门结构分析、专业化指数、shift-share分解方法，考察经济与人口演变
AI.findings: 研究发现：1) 竞争力丧失；2) 正规就业下降；3) 人口老龄化；4) 年轻劳动力持续外流；5) 对单一农业活动的结构性依赖导致持久停滞
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献：1) 深化了对小型农村经济脆弱性的理解；2) 揭示了农业市场波动对专业化经济体的影响机制；3) 丰富了内生创新驱动缺失的理论解释；4) 为巴西内陆地区发展挑战提供了实证案例

title: Mix Me the Perfect Stress Test
affiliations: Oliver Wyman

detail.title: Mix Me the Perfect Stress Test
detail.abstract: The success of stress testing to help end the Global Financial Crisis (GFC) motivated its inclusion in the post-GFC revisions to the regulatory capital regime. There is no perfect stress test design, but there are some desirable features: A) Multiple scenarios: One scenario is simply not enough to cover the space of relevant risks. B) Horizon length and time-step: Three-year scenarios using quarterly time-steps: to adequately capture different loss and revenue dynamics with acceptable model forecast deterioration, and to match financial reporting cadence. C) Models: Both banks and supervisors need to build their own set of models. D) Supervisor and bank (ICAAP): Supervisory (top-down) and bank (bottom up) stress tests, should be run simultaneously. E) How often: More is often better, but it is not costless. Annual for the largest and most complex banks, every other year for the next tier of banks. F) Disclosure: More is better, but because of strategic behavior, there can be too much disclosure. G) Exploratory scenarios and reverse stress testing: Both are excellent tools – supervisors should use them more extensively.

AI.tldr: 该论文讨论了压力测试在金融危机后的监管资本制度中的重要性，并提出了理想压力测试设计的七个关键特征，包括多情景、时间跨度、模型构建、监管与银行协同、频率、信息披露以及探索性情景等要素。
AI.research_question: 如何设计有效的压力测试框架以增强金融体系的稳定性？
AI.motivation: 全球金融危机期间压力测试的成功应用促使其被纳入危机后的监管资本制度修订，但需要确定理想压力测试设计的关键特征。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于风险管理理论、监管资本理论和压力测试方法论，强调系统性风险防范和前瞻性监管的重要性。
AI.method: 规范性分析框架，通过理论推导提出压力测试设计的七个关键特征，基于金融危机后的监管实践和经验总结。
AI.findings: 提出了理想压力测试设计的七个特征：多情景覆盖、三年期季度时间步长、监管与银行各自建模、同步进行监管与银行压力测试、差异化频率安排、适度信息披露、以及探索性情景和反向压力测试的广泛应用。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了系统性的压力测试设计理论框架，为监管压力测试提供了完整的理论指导，丰富了风险管理理论在监管实践中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构和银行提供了具体的压力测试实施指南，包括情景设计、时间框架、模型开发、测试频率和披露策略等操作性建议，有助于提升金融体系的抗风险能力。

title: Easy Money? Refunding the Second Liberty Loan

detail.title: Easy Money? Refunding the Second Liberty Loan
detail.abstract: Upturning long-standing lore related to the ’easy money’ policy of the Federal Reserve Banks, this paper attributes the boom in U.S. stock prices that began in 1927 to the sudden redemption of the Second Liberty Loan. Described as ’one of the largest government operations conducted during peacetime,’ the Treasury’s programme for retiring the Second Liberty Loan not only unlocked a wall of reinvestment, which it steered into stocks by structurally-lowering the long-term rate, but also impressed itself on the monetary policy of the Federal Reserve Banks. Consistent with the Minsky-Kindleberger model, the argument is supported by the market displacement observed before the Tulip Bubble (1637), South Sea Bubble (1720), Mississippi Bubble (1720), Panic of 1825, Berlin Stock Market Bubble (1872), and Barings Crisis (1890).

AI.tldr: 这篇论文挑战了关于美联储"宽松货币政策"的传统观点，认为1927年开始的美国股市繁荣实际上是由第二次自由贷款突然赎回引发的，而非美联储政策。
AI.research_question: 1927年开始的美国股市繁荣的真正驱动因素是什么？是传统认为的美联储"宽松货币政策"，还是第二次自由贷款的赎回？
AI.motivation: 挑战长期以来关于美联储"宽松货币政策"导致1927年股市繁荣的传统观点，重新解释历史事件。
AI.theoretical_framework: 明斯基-金德尔伯格模型（Minsky-Kindleberger model），该模型解释了金融泡沫的形成机制。
AI.method: 历史事件比较分析，将1927年事件与历史上的金融泡沫（郁金香泡沫1637、南海泡沫1720、密西西比泡沫1720、1825年恐慌、柏林股市泡沫1872、巴林危机1890）进行对比。
AI.findings: 第二次自由贷款的赎回释放了大量再投资资金，通过结构性降低长期利率引导资金流入股市，并影响了美联储的货币政策，这才是1927年股市繁荣的真正原因。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战了传统的美联储"宽松货币政策"解释框架；2. 将政府债务操作与资产价格泡沫联系起来；3. 验证了明斯基-金德尔伯格模型在解释历史金融泡沫中的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为理解政府债务管理对金融市场的影响提供新视角；2. 有助于政策制定者识别可能导致资产价格泡沫的政府操作；3. 为金融市场监管提供历史借鉴。

title: The Aggregate–Perception Divergence Theory An Ethological Theory of Human Economic Behavior
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Aggregate–Perception Divergence Theory An Ethological Theory of Human Economic Behavior
detail.abstract: This paper introduces the Aggregate-Perception Divergence Theory (APDT) to explain the structural gap between improving macroeconomic indicators and deteriorating individual perceptions of stability. While institutional metrics (GDP, employment, aggregate safety) may signal systemic growth, subjective experience often reports heightened anxiety. We formalize individual perception (P_i) as a function of aggregate conditions modulated by perceived volatility, asymmetric risk exposure, and informational salience. This framework identifies a Perception Instability Equilibrium (PIE), where institutional stability and widespread subjective fragility coexist. The paper contributes to behavioral microeconomics by demonstrating how modern information density and risk asymmetry decouple statistical reality from perceived experience.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了聚合-感知分歧理论（APDT），解释宏观经济指标改善与个体稳定感恶化之间的结构性差距。研究发现，制度性指标（GDP、就业、总体安全）可能显示系统性增长，但主观体验却报告更高的焦虑感。
AI.research_question: 为什么在宏观经济指标改善的情况下，个体对稳定性的感知却不断恶化？
AI.motivation: 观察到宏观经济指标（如GDP、就业率、总体安全）显示系统性增长，但个体主观体验却报告更高的焦虑感，这种聚合指标与个体感知之间的分歧需要理论解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 聚合-感知分歧理论（APDT），将个体感知（P_i）形式化为聚合条件的函数，受感知波动性、非对称风险暴露和信息显著性调节。提出了感知不稳定均衡（PIE）概念。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，通过形式化框架分析个体感知与聚合指标之间的关系，识别感知不稳定均衡的存在条件。
AI.findings: 存在感知不稳定均衡（PIE），即制度稳定性和广泛的主观脆弱性可以共存。现代信息密度和风险非对称性导致统计现实与感知体验脱钩。
AI.theory_contributions: 对行为微观经济学的贡献：展示了现代信息密度和风险非对称性如何使统计现实与感知体验脱钩，提出了解释聚合-感知分歧的新理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了理解为什么在良好经济指标下公众仍感到不安的理论工具，有助于设计更有效的沟通和政策干预策略。

title: The added value of an interdisciplinary academic primary care network in Belgium: a qualitative external evaluation using Soft Systems Methodology
affiliations: UCLouvain, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Liège - Department of Public Health and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The added value of an interdisciplinary academic primary care network in Belgium: a qualitative external evaluation using Soft Systems Methodology
detail.abstract: Be.Hive is an interdisciplinary academic chair in primary care in French-speaking Belgium that seeks to strengthen primary care by connecting research, teaching, practice, and policy. Created in 2019, it convenes universities, university colleges, primary care professionals, patient and caregiver organisations, and policy actors to address persistent fragmentation. This study evaluated the added value of Be.Hive as a social and organisational innovation, from the perspective of stakeholders outside its governance structures. We conducted a qualitative external evaluation using Soft Systems Methodology (SSM) to examine how Be.Hive is perceived, used, and valued. SSM informed the design of focus groups and collective sense-making workshops, supporting participants to articulate differing worldviews, surface tensions, and co-identify feasible improvements. Participants were representatives of professional platforms, policy administrations, patient and caregiver organisations, and meso-level support structures. Data were analysed iteratively using constant comparative methods. Stakeholders highlighted contributions in three interrelated domains: (1) capacity building through co-financing and mentoring of doctoral work anchored in primary care; (2) knowledge integration via participatory research, interdisciplinary workshops, and communities of practice linking academia, practitioners, and citizens; and (3) policy and system support through white papers, targeted analyses, and sustained engagement with regional and federal platforms. Reported challenges concerned role clarity, visibility, and alignment between expectations for system change and the boundaries of an academic mandate.

AI.tldr: Be.Hive是比利时法语区初级保健跨学科学术主席，旨在通过连接研究、教学、实践和政策来加强初级保健。本研究使用软系统方法评估了Be.Hive作为社会和组织创新的附加价值，发现其在能力建设、知识整合和政策支持三个领域做出贡献，但也面临角色清晰度、可见性和系统变革期望与学术职责边界之间的挑战。
AI.research_question: Be.Hive作为社会和组织创新，从治理结构外部的利益相关者视角看，其附加价值是什么？
AI.motivation: 初级保健领域存在持续的分割问题，需要连接研究、教学、实践和政策来加强初级保健系统。Be.Hive作为跨学科学术主席，旨在解决这种分割，但其作为社会和组织创新的实际价值需要评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 软系统方法论（Soft Systems Methodology, SSM）作为理论基础，强调不同世界观、表面张力识别和共同改进的可行性。
AI.method: 定性外部评估，使用软系统方法论（SSM）设计焦点小组和集体意义建构工作坊，参与者包括专业平台、政策管理部门、患者和照顾者组织以及中观支持结构的代表，采用持续比较方法进行迭代数据分析。
AI.findings: 利益相关者强调了Be.Hive在三个相互关联领域的贡献：(1)通过共同资助和指导初级保健相关的博士工作实现能力建设；(2)通过参与式研究、跨学科工作坊和连接学术界、从业者和公民的实践社区实现知识整合；(3)通过白皮书、针对性分析和与区域和联邦平台的持续接触提供政策和系统支持。报告的挑战涉及角色清晰度、可见性以及系统变革期望与学术职责边界之间的协调。
AI.theory_contributions: 本研究展示了软系统方法论在评估复杂跨学科组织创新中的应用价值，为理解学术-实践-政策连接机制提供了理论框架，并为评估社会和组织创新的附加价值提供了方法论贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为Be.Hive提供了改进建议，包括增强角色清晰度和可见性，更好地协调学术职责与系统变革期望；为类似跨学科组织提供了能力建设、知识整合和政策支持的成功模式；为初级保健系统的整合提供了可操作的实践路径。

title:
A Critical Review on 2026 Election Manifestos by Major Political Parties in Bangladesh 
Promises, Priorities, and Practicality
affiliations: Centre for Resilience and Youth

detail.title:
A Critical Review on 2026 Election Manifestos by Major Political Parties in Bangladesh 
Promises, Priorities, and Practicality
detail.abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive critical analysis of the 2026 Bangladesh election manifestos from three major political parties: the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP), the National Citizens Party (NCP), and Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. The analysis examines each party's core agenda, identifies areas of cross-party consensus and divergence, and critically evaluates the feasibility of key promises. While all three parties demonstrate remarkable agreement on fundamental reforms-including justice for past atrocities, electoral system overhaul, anti-corruption measures, and universal healthcare-they differ significantly in their approaches to electoral architecture, constitutional identity, economic intervention, and foreign policy. The paper concludes by highlighting several ambitious commitments that appear impractical given current fiscal, administrative, and geopolitical constraints, raising important questions about the gap between electoral rhetoric and governance reality.

AI.tldr: 对2026年孟加拉国三大政党选举宣言的批判性分析，揭示核心议程共识与分歧，评估关键承诺的可行性
AI.research_question: 孟加拉国三大政党（BNP、NCP、Jamaat-e-Islami）在2026年选举宣言中的核心议程是什么？它们存在哪些共识与分歧？关键承诺在当前财政、行政和地缘政治约束下的可行性如何？
AI.motivation: 分析选举宣言中政治承诺与现实治理之间的差距，揭示政党竞选修辞与实际可行性之间的脱节，为理解孟加拉国政治发展提供批判性视角
AI.theoretical_framework: 选举宣言分析框架、政治承诺可行性理论、政党议程比较研究、治理现实与选举修辞差距理论
AI.method: 对三大政党选举宣言的批判性内容分析，识别核心议程、共识与分歧点，基于财政、行政和地缘政治约束评估承诺可行性
AI.findings: 三大政党在基本改革（历史罪行司法、选举制度改革、反腐败、全民医疗）上存在显著共识，但在选举架构、宪法身份、经济干预和外交政策上存在重大分歧；许多雄心勃勃的承诺在当前约束下不切实际
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了选举宣言可行性评估框架，深化了对发展中国家政治承诺与现实治理差距的理解，为政党议程比较研究提供新视角
AI.practical_contributions: 为选民提供批判性分析工具识别可行与不可行承诺，为政策制定者提供现实约束下的改革建议，促进更负责任的选举政治

title: Public Good Theory of Financial Inclusion
affiliations: Researcher

detail.title: Public Good Theory of Financial Inclusion

publicationDetails.detailsText: In Book: Finance, Technology, and Sustainability for Sustainable Innovation (pp. 21-30). IGI Global

detail.abstract: Financial inclusion as a public good can be funded by the State and private firms to ensure that everyone has affordable access to formal financial services. Historically, the economic solution for financial inclusion has been to create public banks and issue banking license to private banks. Today, the solution for financial inclusion lies in offering public support to financial service providers to ensure that formal financial services is available and affordable so that everyone can access and use financial services to meet their needs. This article discusses the need to treat financial inclusion as a public good because financial inclusion is essential for the economic and social development of any nation. This article presents a detailed understanding of the public good theory of financial inclusion. It explains the sense in which financial inclusion is a public good and it explores the implications for development policy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出应将金融包容性视为公共产品，并探讨了其作为公共产品的理论基础及对发展政策的影响。
AI.research_question: 金融包容性为何应被视为公共产品？作为公共产品的金融包容性对发展政策有何启示？
AI.motivation: 金融包容性对任何国家的经济和社会发展都至关重要，但传统上通过创建公共银行和发放私人银行牌照的解决方案已不足以确保所有人都能获得可负担的正式金融服务。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共产品理论，探讨金融包容性作为公共产品的特性及其理论基础。
AI.method: 理论分析，通过概念框架探讨金融包容性作为公共产品的理论依据和政策含义。
AI.findings: 金融包容性具有公共产品的特性，需要国家和私人企业的共同资助；现代解决方案是通过向金融服务提供商提供公共支持，确保正式金融服务可及且可负担。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了金融包容性的公共产品理论框架，阐明了金融包容性作为公共产品的理论依据和特性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了将金融包容性作为公共产品进行资助和管理的政策建议，强调需要国家和私人部门的协同支持。

title: Deciphering Hydrochemical Evolution, Source Apportionment, and Health Risk Prioritization in a Typical Arid/Semi-Arid Coal-Mining Area
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, China Medical University and Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS) - State Key Laboratory of Urban and Regional Ecology

detail.title: Deciphering Hydrochemical Evolution, Source Apportionment, and Health Risk Prioritization in a Typical Arid/Semi-Arid Coal-Mining Area
detail.abstract: In arid/semi-arid coal-mining regions, groundwater serves as the primary source for domestic, agricultural, and industrial water supply, yet its chemical composition is increasingly altered by intensive anthropogenic disturbances. A critical knowledge gap persists in quantitatively disentangling the coupled effects of natural hydrogeochemical evolution and multi-source anthropogenic inputs, and in translating this understanding into management-relevant risk prioritization. To address this issue, this study focused on the Huolingol mining area, a typical coal-mining region in Inner Mongolia, China, and integrated unsupervised machine learning (SOM), Entropy weight-technique for order of preference by similarity to ideal solution (EW-TOPSIS), positive matrix factorization (PMF), and Monte Carlo health risk simulation to construct a “hydrochemical differentiation-source apportionment-risk prioritization” framework. Groundwater samples were classified into three clusters: Na-HCO3/Ca-Na-HCO3 water dominated by intense cation exchange and silicate weathering (Cluster 1), Ca-Na-SO4/Ca-Na-HCO3 water influenced by anthropogenic contamination (Cluster 2), and Ca-HCO3 water representing the natural background (Cluster 3). Source apportionment using PMF revealed that human-driven composite pollution is the main cause of water quality evolution, with the mixed source of coal mine drainage and industrial/domestic wastewater contributing the highest proportion (22.42%), highlighting the overwhelming impact of mining and industrial activities. Health risk simulation indicated that groundwater contamination poses a more severe threat to children, whose probability of exceeding the non-carcinogenic risk threshold (33.9%) was considerably higher than that of adults (19.4%). F- and SO42- were identified as the primary risk-driving factors. By deciphering the “chemical fingerprint” and “risk code” of groundwater under intensive anthropogenic disturbance, this work provides a replicable paradigm for groundwater management in arid and semi-arid mining regions worldwide.

AI.tldr: 本研究针对干旱/半干旱煤矿区地下水化学组分受人为干扰的问题，构建了"水化学分异-源解析-风险排序"框架，结合多种分析方法揭示了人类活动是水质演变主因，儿童面临更高健康风险，为全球类似矿区地下水管理提供了可复制范式。
AI.research_question: 如何定量解析干旱/半干旱煤矿区地下水化学组分的自然水文地球化学演化与多源人为输入的耦合效应，并将这种理解转化为管理相关的风险优先级排序？
AI.motivation: 在干旱/半干旱煤矿区，地下水是生活、农业和工业用水的主要来源，但其化学组分受到强烈人为干扰。目前缺乏定量解析自然演化与人为输入耦合效应的方法，以及将这种理解转化为风险管理优先级的系统框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 水文地球化学演化理论、人为干扰对地下水质量影响理论、健康风险评估理论、多源污染源解析理论。
AI.method: 整合无监督机器学习(SOM)、熵权-TOPSIS法、正矩阵分解(PMF)和蒙特卡洛健康风险模拟，构建"水化学分异-源解析-风险排序"框架，应用于内蒙古霍林郭勒矿区地下水样本分析。
AI.findings: 1. 地下水样本分为三类：受强烈阳离子交换和硅酸盐风化主导的Na-HCO3/Ca-Na-HCO3水(集群1)；受人为污染影响的Ca-Na-SO4/Ca-Na-HCO3水(集群2)；代表自然背景的Ca-HCO3水(集群3)。2. PMF源解析显示人类驱动的复合污染是水质演变主因，煤矿排水与工业/生活污水混合源贡献最高(22.42%)。3. 健康风险模拟表明地下水污染对儿童威胁更严重，超标概率(33.9%)显著高于成人(19.4%)，F-和SO42-是主要风险驱动因子。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了整合水化学分异、污染源解析和健康风险排序的系统理论框架。2. 发展了定量解析自然水文地球化学演化与多源人为输入耦合效应的方法论。3. 建立了从"化学指纹"到"风险代码"的转化理论，为地下水风险管理提供理论支撑。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为霍林郭勒矿区地下水管理提供了具体科学依据。2. 识别了煤矿排水与工业/生活污水混合源为优先控制污染源。3. 明确了儿童为高风险人群，F-和SO42-为关键控制污染物。4. 提供了可复制的地下水管理范式，适用于全球干旱/半干旱矿区。

title: Stabilising Sentiment: Macroprudential Policy and House Price Expectations in Ireland
affiliations: and

detail.title: Stabilising Sentiment: Macroprudential Policy and House Price Expectations in Ireland

publicationDetails.detailsText: Central Bank of Ireland Research Paper Series No. 12, 2025
publicationDetails.journalName: Central Bank of Ireland Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: In this Insight, we provide preliminary evidence consistent with the existence of an expectations channel of BBMs, operating as follows: once buyers, sellers, and lenders know that the possibility of unsustainable credit-price spirals has been curtailed by mortgage debt limits, this constraint feeds into house price expectations, which in turn influences housing market decisions on impact. In line with a large macro-finance literature focussed on the US housing boom-bust cycle around the Global Financial Crisis, expectations are a key channel through which feedback loops between house prices and credit can emerge. However, their influence is wider than through banks and borrowers: they can also influence behaviour of investors purchasing without mortgage finance, as well as brokers and other important agents in the housing market.

AI.tldr: 本文初步证据表明，抵押贷款债务限制通过预期渠道影响房价预期，进而影响住房市场决策，这一机制不仅影响银行和借款人，还影响无抵押融资的投资者、经纪人等市场参与者。
AI.research_question: 抵押贷款债务限制（BBMs）如何通过预期渠道影响住房市场决策？
AI.motivation: 理解宏观审慎政策（如抵押贷款债务限制）如何通过影响市场参与者的预期来调节房价-信贷反馈循环，特别是在全球金融危机后美国房地产繁荣-萧条周期的背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于宏观金融文献中的预期渠道理论，特别是关于房价与信贷之间反馈循环的文献，强调预期在住房市场动态中的核心作用。
AI.method: 初步证据分析（Insight文章），基于现有文献和理论框架进行论证。
AI.findings: 初步证据表明抵押贷款债务限制通过影响房价预期来调节住房市场决策，这一预期渠道不仅影响传统银行和借款人，还扩展到无抵押融资的投资者、经纪人等其他市场参与者。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了宏观审慎政策的传导机制理论，强调了预期渠道在调节房价-信贷反馈循环中的重要性，并将预期影响范围从传统金融参与者扩展到更广泛的市场主体。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计更有效的宏观审慎工具提供了理论依据，强调了通过管理市场预期来稳定住房市场的重要性，特别是考虑到预期影响的多主体性。

title: The Worth of a «Wo»: Gender Bias in Financial Advice from LLMs
affiliations: NHH Norwegian School of Economics - Department of Economics and NHH Norwegian School of Economics - Department of Economics

detail.title: The Worth of a «Wo»: Gender Bias in Financial Advice from LLMs

publicationDetails.detailsText: NHH Dept. of Economics Discussion Paper No. 04/2026
publicationDetails.journalName: Norwegian School of Economics, Department of Economics Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Do large language models (LLMs) provide gender-neutral financial advice? We answer this question by prompting 33 widely used LLMs from five vendors, varying only a single word in otherwise identical prompts: "man" versus "woman." We find that women are advised to allocate 1.8 percentage points less to equity funds than men; this gap persists across vendors, model generations, and model complexity. Providing richer investor information attenuates but does not entirely eliminate the gender gap. Since even modest allocation differences imply persistent return differentials, algorithmic financial advice can shape wealth accumulation across demographic groups.

AI.tldr: 研究发现大型语言模型在提供金融建议时存在性别偏见，女性被建议投资股票基金的比例比男性低1.8个百分点，这种差异在不同供应商、模型世代和复杂度中都存在。
AI.research_question: 大型语言模型是否提供性别中立的金融建议？
AI.motivation: 随着算法金融建议的普及，了解LLMs是否存在系统性性别偏见对确保公平财富积累至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 算法偏见理论、金融建议中的性别差异、财富积累不平等
AI.method: 使用5个供应商的33个广泛使用的LLMs，通过仅改变提示中"男人"与"女人"一个词来测试性别偏见，并分析不同信息丰富度的影响。
AI.findings: 女性被建议投资股票基金的比例比男性低1.8个百分点；这种性别差距在不同供应商、模型世代和复杂度中都存在；提供更丰富的投资者信息可以减弱但不能完全消除性别差距。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地证明了LLMs在金融建议中存在性别偏见，扩展了算法偏见理论在金融领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了算法金融建议可能加剧财富不平等，为监管机构、金融机构和AI开发者提供了改进建议系统公平性的依据。

title: Budgetary Policy and the Irish Income Tax System Since 2011
affiliations: Central Bank and Financial Services Authority of Ireland

detail.title: Budgetary Policy and the Irish Income Tax System Since 2011

publicationDetails.detailsText: Central Bank of Ireland Research Paper Series No. 11, 2025
publicationDetails.journalName: Central Bank of Ireland Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This Insight examines how budgetary policy since 2011, a period of improved Irish economic performance after the crisis years of the late 2000s, has affected the income tax take and considers the impact of such changes on average tax rates across the income distribution. After the 2011 Budget, there were no noteworthy income tax changes until the mid-2010s. Thereafter, general income tax measures in Budgets have involved a reduction in the higher rate of income tax (from 41 per cent to 40 per cent in the 2015 Budget), increases in standard rate bands and personal and employee tax credits, and reductions in USC rates and changes in USC bands.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了2011年后爱尔兰经济复苏时期的预算政策如何影响所得税收入，以及这些变化对不同收入阶层平均税率的影响。
AI.research_question: 2011年后爱尔兰的预算政策如何影响所得税收入？这些税收变化对不同收入分布的平均税率产生了什么影响？
AI.motivation: 爱尔兰在2000年代末危机后经济表现改善，需要研究这一时期预算政策对税收体系的影响，特别是对不同收入阶层的税收负担变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 税收政策分析、收入分配理论、预算政策对税收收入影响的理论框架。
AI.method: 基于预算文件和政策变化的分析，考察2011年后爱尔兰预算中的所得税措施变化，包括税率调整、税收抵免和税级变化。
AI.findings: 2011年预算后直到2010年代中期没有重大所得税变化；之后政策包括：高收入税率从41%降至40%，标准税率区间扩大，个人和雇员税收抵免增加，USC税率降低和税级调整。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了经济复苏时期预算政策对税收体系影响的实证分析，丰富了税收政策与收入分配关系的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于税收政策调整对不同收入阶层影响的实证证据，有助于未来设计更公平有效的税收体系。

title: Symposium Issue: U.S.-EU Comparative Financial Regulation

Ross School of Business

detail.title: Symposium Issue: U.S.-EU Comparative Financial Regulation

publicationDetails.detailsText: Duke Law School Public Law & Legal Theory Series Forthcoming
publicationDetails.journalName: Duke Law School Public Law & Legal Theory Research Paper Series

publicationDetails.detailsText: 88 Law and Contemporary Problems issue no. 2 (2026)

detail.abstract: This symposium issue seeks to harmonize international financial regulation by comparing and critiquing U.S. and EU approaches, including their convergences and divergences and the reasons therefor. To achieve this goal, the issue introduces a somewhat innovative approach: each article is co-authored by leading U.S. and EU financial regulation scholars. The divergences in the U.S. and EU financial regulatory frameworks might be explained, at least in part, by the differences in the structure of their financial systems: the United States is primarily market-based, whereas the European Union is largely bank-based. 1 For example, approximately 80% of corporate financing in the United States is funded through the capital markets, compared to only 30% in the European Union. 2 Another possible explanation for the divergences is that EU regulators and the European Central Bank have been more willing to impose top-down policy than their U.S. counterparts, which tend to rely more on voluntary, market-led efforts. Recognizing these differences, this symposium issue's comparative analyses should help the United States and the European Union learn from each other's regulatory successes and failures. That, in turn, should help identify "best practices" and increase regulatory efficiency. The comparative analyses should also further economic growth by increasing U.S. and EU regulatory convergence, building trust, and encouraging cross-border market access and business relationships. The demand for such cross-border access and business is increasingly critical with the expansion of crypto-assets and decentralized finance (DeFi), which transcend geographic boundaries. Regulatory convergence should also increase legal certainty, reduce regulatory risk, lower compliance costs, and facilitate more cooperative cross-border regulatory supervision. Additionally, such convergence could provide more common crisis responses to similar market failures, thereby reducing cross-border financial contagion.

AI.tldr: 本专题论文集通过比较美欧金融监管框架的异同，探讨国际金融监管协调路径，旨在促进监管趋同、降低合规成本、增强跨境监管合作。
AI.research_question: 如何通过比较美欧金融监管框架的异同，促进国际金融监管协调与趋同？
AI.motivation: 随着加密资产和去中心化金融(DeFi)等跨境金融活动的发展，美欧金融监管框架的差异可能导致监管套利、增加合规成本、阻碍跨境市场准入，需要协调监管以应对这些挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 比较金融监管理论、监管趋同理论、制度差异理论（市场导向vs银行导向的金融体系）、监管协调理论
AI.method: 比较分析法：通过美欧学者合作撰写论文，系统比较美欧金融监管框架的异同、原因及影响
AI.findings: 1. 美欧金融监管差异部分源于金融体系结构不同（美国市场导向vs欧盟银行导向）；2. 欧盟监管机构更倾向于自上而下的政策干预，而美国更依赖市场自愿机制；3. 监管趋同可带来法律确定性增强、合规成本降低、跨境监管合作改善等益处
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 深化对金融体系结构差异如何影响监管框架的理解；2. 为监管趋同理论提供实证支持；3. 拓展跨境金融监管协调的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为美欧监管机构提供相互学习的实践案例；2. 识别"最佳实践"以提高监管效率；3. 促进跨境市场准入和商业关系；4. 为应对加密资产和DeFi等新兴跨境金融挑战提供政策建议

title: Household Resilience to Current Income and Cost-of-Living Shocks
affiliations: and Bank of Ireland

detail.title: Household Resilience to Current Income and Cost-of-Living Shocks

publicationDetails.detailsText: Central Bank of Ireland Research Paper Series No. 10, 2025
publicationDetails.journalName: Central Bank of Ireland Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: • Household balance sheets have strengthened since 2018 and are projected to remain resilient under a baseline scenario for the domestic economy. In an adverse scenario where interest rates and the cost-of-living increases, the share of mortgages at risk could rise modestly relative to the 2024 level, from 6.4 to 8.7 per cent. Despite current levels of resilience, there is still a group of lower-income households that are more vulnerable. Under this particular adverse scenario, the share of mortgages at risk in the bottom third of income distribution (representing around 7.6 per cent of the share of mortgages) is 35 per cent.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了家庭资产负债表在2018年后的改善情况，并预测了在不同经济情景下的抵押贷款风险。研究发现家庭资产负债表整体稳健，但在不利情景下，低收入家庭的抵押贷款风险会显著上升。
AI.research_question: 家庭资产负债表在不同经济情景下的韧性如何？特别是低收入家庭的抵押贷款风险在利率上升和生活成本增加的情况下会有怎样的变化？
AI.motivation: 了解家庭资产负债表在当前经济环境下的韧性，特别是识别哪些群体在不利经济情景下更容易受到冲击，对于政策制定和风险管理至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于家庭金融理论、资产负债表分析框架和情景分析理论，研究家庭资产负债表在不同经济冲击下的脆弱性。
AI.method: 采用情景分析方法，包括基线情景和不利情景（利率上升和生活成本增加），通过数据建模分析不同收入群体抵押贷款风险的变化。
AI.findings: 1. 家庭资产负债表自2018年以来有所加强，在基线情景下保持韧性；2. 在不利情景下，抵押贷款风险比例从6.4%上升到8.7%；3. 低收入家庭（收入分布底部三分之一）的抵押贷款风险比例高达35%，占抵押贷款总额的7.6%。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了家庭资产负债表脆弱性的理论框架，特别关注收入分布对风险暴露的影响，为理解不同收入群体在宏观经济冲击下的差异化反应提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了识别脆弱群体的依据，建议针对低收入家庭制定针对性的风险管理措施；为金融机构提供了压力测试的参考框架，有助于更好地评估抵押贷款组合的风险。

title: What Next for the Dublin Office Vacancy Rate? A Framework to Examine Short-run Scenarios
affiliations: and

detail.title: What Next for the Dublin Office Vacancy Rate? A Framework to Examine Short-run Scenarios

publicationDetails.detailsText: Central Bank of Ireland Research Paper Series No. 9, 2025
publicationDetails.journalName: Central Bank of Ireland Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: •  Notwithstanding some recent signs of stabilisation, Dublin’s office market has been amongst the hardest hit across Europe in terms of decrease in capital values, fall-off in investment and the rise in vacancy rates since the start of the decade. The extent of the slowdown, however, has not been as sharp as in some large US cities. Using an enhanced methodological framework to project short-run vacancy rates, the central scenario for the Dublin office vacancy rate is a marginal rise to just over 19 per cent in 2026 before falling back below end of 2024 levels (18.6 per cent) by the end of 2027. A scenario based on a more benign set of assumptions suggests that the Dublin office vacancy rate may have already peaked, while the more adverse case sees a return to levels last seen around the time of the Irish property market collapse in 2009. In contrast to the 2009 episode, any further significant increase in office vacancy would occur against a markedly different CRE landscape, where current risks are much less concentrated within the domestic financial system.

AI.tldr: 本文使用增强的方法框架预测都柏林办公市场短期空置率，核心情景显示空置率将在2026年小幅上升至略高于19%，随后在2027年底回落至2024年底水平以下。不同情景分析显示，都柏林办公市场面临的风险已从国内金融体系转向更广泛的市场因素。
AI.research_question: 都柏林办公市场空置率的短期演变趋势如何？不同经济情景下都柏林办公市场空置率将如何变化？
AI.motivation: 都柏林办公市场是欧洲受冲击最严重的市场之一，资本价值下降、投资减少、空置率上升。尽管近期有稳定迹象，但市场前景仍不明朗，需要更精确的短期预测来指导决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 房地产周期理论、市场供需分析、情景分析框架、风险分散理论
AI.method: 使用增强的方法框架进行短期空置率预测，包括核心情景、良性情景和不利情景三种情景分析
AI.findings: 核心情景：都柏林办公空置率将在2026年小幅上升至略高于19%，随后在2027年底回落至18.6%以下；良性情景：空置率可能已经见顶；不利情景：可能回到2009年爱尔兰房地产市场崩溃时的水平。与2009年不同，当前风险不再集中于国内金融体系。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了增强的短期空置率预测方法框架；对比了当前市场风险与2009年金融危机时期的风险分布差异；验证了情景分析在房地产预测中的应用价值
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者、开发商和政策制定者提供了都柏林办公市场的短期预测；识别了不同经济情景下的市场风险；帮助利益相关者做出更明智的房地产投资决策

title: SME Profitability in an Adverse Macroeconomic Environment
affiliations: and Al Alkhawayn University

detail.title: SME Profitability in an Adverse Macroeconomic Environment

publicationDetails.detailsText: Central Bank of Ireland Research Paper Series No. 8, 2025
publicationDetails.journalName: Central Bank of Ireland Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: • Irish SMEs are expected to continue posting positive and stable profit margins under the central scenario for the domestic economy. In an adverse scenario which assumes a sharp deterioration in the global and domestic macro-financial environment driven by heightened geoeconomic tensions, SME profit margins fall sharply. Sectors with the greatest trade exposures suffer the largest drop in profitability. While the adverse scenario projects a large increase in the proportion of loss-making SMEs, the number of firms entering financial distress is more modest. This provides confidence in the resilience of Irish SMEs, even under stress conditions.

AI.tldr: 爱尔兰中小企业在国内经济基准情景下预计保持稳定盈利，但在地缘经济紧张加剧的负面情景下，盈利能力将大幅下降，贸易敞口大的行业受影响最严重。尽管亏损企业比例大幅增加，但陷入财务困境的企业数量相对有限，表明爱尔兰中小企业具有韧性。
AI.research_question: 在不同宏观经济情景下，爱尔兰中小企业的盈利能力如何变化？哪些因素影响其财务韧性？
AI.motivation: 评估爱尔兰中小企业在不同宏观经济环境下的财务表现和韧性，为政策制定者和企业提供风险管理和应对策略的参考。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宏观经济情景分析框架、企业财务韧性理论、贸易敞口与盈利能力关系理论
AI.method: 情景分析法，包括基准情景和负面情景（地缘经济紧张加剧导致全球和国内宏观金融环境恶化），分析不同情景下中小企业盈利能力和财务困境情况
AI.findings: 1. 基准情景下爱尔兰中小企业保持稳定盈利；2. 负面情景下盈利能力大幅下降，贸易敞口大的行业受影响最严重；3. 尽管亏损企业比例大幅增加，但陷入财务困境的企业数量相对有限
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了中小企业财务韧性理论，验证了贸易敞口与盈利能力的关系在不同宏观经济情景下的表现，为情景分析在中小企业研究中的应用提供实证支持
AI.practical_contributions: 为爱尔兰中小企业提供风险管理参考，帮助政策制定者设计针对性支持措施，为金融机构评估中小企业信贷风险提供依据，增强企业对宏观经济冲击的应对能力

title: Wins, Windfalls and Willpower: Liquidity and Self-Regulation in Online Sports Gambling
affiliations: UNSW Australia Business School, School of Banking and Finance, The University of Sydney, The University of Sydney, The University of Sydney - Discipline of Finance and

detail.title: Wins, Windfalls and Willpower: Liquidity and Self-Regulation in Online Sports Gambling
detail.abstract: We study how gambling behavior responds to prior-day outcomes, liquidity shocks, and bettors' awareness of potential harm, using betting data for a random sample of 24,453 online sports bettors. Relative to days with no resolved bets, bettors are 7 to 8 percentage points more likely to place a bet following either a win or a loss. Bettors increase their stake size after wins and shift toward higher-odds bets after losses. Liquidity windfalls from annual tax refunds do not affect the gambling participation rate, but lead to stake escalation among bettors vulnerable to gambling harm. Safe-gambling tools curb betting only when they directly limit engagement with the platform. Reminder-based awareness nudges, which notify bettors when their gambling expenditure or time spent on the gambling platform exceeds self-set limits, reduce participation but shift bets toward higher-risk wagers.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用24,453名在线体育博彩者的随机样本数据，分析了赌博行为如何受到前一天结果、流动性冲击和对潜在危害认知的影响。研究发现赌客在赢或输后都更可能继续下注，但赢后增加赌注，输后转向高赔率投注。税收返还等流动性冲击不影响参与率但增加高风险赌客的赌注。安全赌博工具仅在直接限制平台参与时有效，提醒式认知干预减少参与但转向更高风险投注。
AI.research_question: 赌博行为如何受到前一天结果（赢/输）、流动性冲击（如税收返还）以及赌客对潜在危害的认知（通过安全赌博工具和提醒）的影响？
AI.motivation: 理解赌博行为的驱动因素对于制定有效的赌博危害预防政策至关重要。现有研究对赌客如何响应不同刺激（如输赢结果、财务冲击、认知干预）的了解有限，特别是在真实世界在线赌博环境中的行为反应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学理论，包括损失厌恶、追逐损失、心理账户理论、流动性约束理论，以及行为干预理论（如提醒和认知干预）。
AI.method: 使用24,453名在线体育博彩者的随机样本数据，通过实证分析研究赌博行为对前一天结果、流动性冲击（年度税收返还）和安全赌博工具/提醒的反应。
AI.findings: 1. 相对于没有结算投注的日子，赌客在赢或输后都更可能下注（增加7-8个百分点）。2. 赢后增加赌注规模，输后转向更高赔率的投注。3. 税收返还等流动性冲击不影响赌博参与率，但增加易受赌博危害的赌客的赌注。4. 安全赌博工具仅在直接限制平台参与时有效。5. 提醒式认知干预减少参与但转向更高风险投注。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了对赌博行为响应机制的理解，特别是输赢结果的非对称影响。2. 揭示了流动性冲击对赌博行为的异质性影响。3. 提供了行为干预工具有效性的实证证据，区分了直接限制和提醒干预的不同效果。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为赌博监管机构提供政策设计依据，特别是针对不同风险群体的干预策略。2. 帮助赌博平台设计更有效的负责任赌博工具。3. 提醒政策制定者注意行为干预可能产生的意外后果（如转向更高风险投注）。

title: Gig Informal Workers and Changing Work Cultures in Kashmir: A Qualitative Inquiry
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Gig Informal Workers and Changing Work Cultures in Kashmir: A Qualitative Inquiry

contentType.other: Paper to be published in your journal

detail.abstract: This study explores the changing nature of work cultures in Kashmir through the lens of the gig economy, focusing on employment insecurity, digital platform governance and local labour realities. In a region marked by limited formal employment and recurring economic disruptions, platform-based gig work has emerged as a significant livelihood option for youth and informal workers. Using a qualitative research framework, the study adopted a non-probability sampling technique to collect primary data from 14 gig workers engaged in food and grocery, freelance work, teaching and taxi driving across urban centers of Kashmir. Semi-structured interviews were conducted to capture workers experiences, perceptions and coping strategies within platform-mediated employment. The collected data were systematically analyzed using NVivo 12 software, enabling thematic coding and interpretation. The findings reveal six major dimensions influencing gig workers experiences: income instability, platform control mechanisms, lack of social security, perceived flexibility of work, region-specific uncertainties and coping strategies. While gig work provides short-term income opportunities and autonomy over working hours, it simultaneously reinforces precarious employment conditions and deepens workers vulnerability. The study contributes to emerging research on digital labour and informal employment by situating the gig economy within Kashmir's unique socioeconomic context. It further highlights the need for region-sensitive labour policies, stronger regulatory frameworks, and inclusive social protection measures for gig workers.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了克什米尔地区零工经济中的工作文化变迁，重点关注就业不安全感、数字平台治理和当地劳动力现实。研究发现零工工作虽然提供短期收入和灵活性，但也加剧了就业不稳定性和工人脆弱性。
AI.research_question: 克什米尔地区零工经济如何影响工作文化、就业安全性和工人体验？
AI.motivation: 克什米尔地区正规就业机会有限且经济频繁中断，平台零工工作已成为青年和非正规工人的重要生计选择，需要研究这种新兴就业形式对当地劳动力市场的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字劳动理论、非正规就业理论、平台治理理论、就业不安全感理论
AI.method: 定性研究框架，采用非概率抽样技术，对14名克什米尔城市地区的零工工人（涉及食品杂货、自由职业、教学和出租车驾驶）进行半结构化访谈，使用NVivo 12软件进行系统化主题编码分析
AI.findings: 研究发现影响零工工人体验的六个主要维度：收入不稳定、平台控制机制、缺乏社会保障、感知的工作灵活性、地区特定不确定性以及应对策略。零工工作提供短期收入机会和工作时间自主权，但同时也强化了不稳定的就业条件并加深了工人的脆弱性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将零工经济置于克什米尔独特的社会经济背景下，为数字劳动和非正规就业研究做出贡献；扩展了对平台治理和就业不安全感的理论理解
AI.practical_contributions: 强调需要制定地区敏感的劳动力政策、更强的监管框架以及针对零工工人的包容性社会保障措施；为政策制定者提供关于如何平衡零工经济灵活性与工人保护的实践建议

title: AI Development, Energy Markets, and Macroeconomy: A Dynamic General Equilibrium Analysis

detail.title: AI Development, Energy Markets, and Macroeconomy: A Dynamic General Equilibrium Analysis
detail.abstract: This note quantifies the interplay between AI development, capital accumulation, and energy markets using a three-sector dynamic general equilibrium model calibrated to the Japanese economy. We analyze steady-state shifts driven by a 100 times increase in AI productivity. Our analysis yields four primary findings. First, while Real GDP expands to 2.5 times its initial level, household welfare gains are more modest because the AI-intensive economy necessitates a higher investment share at the expense of household consumption. Second, we identify a quantitative "Jevons paradox": while technological development enhances the energy efficiency of AI, the volume effect of AI demand and the resulting intensified energy consumption drive energy prices up by nearly 7 times. Third, the shift to the new AI-intensive economy induces a huge structural decline in the labor income share from 55% to 31%. Finally, these outcomes are highly sensitive to the elasticity of substitution between labor and AI; a 5% increase in the elasticity doubles the energy price response, highlighting the uncertainty inherent in the shift to an AI-driven era.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用三部门动态一般均衡模型量化AI发展、资本积累与能源市场之间的相互作用。研究发现：AI生产力提升100倍时，实际GDP增长2.5倍但家庭福利改善有限；出现"杰文斯悖论"导致能源价格上涨近7倍；劳动收入份额从55%大幅下降至31%；结果对劳动与AI替代弹性高度敏感。
AI.research_question: AI发展如何影响宏观经济、资本积累和能源市场？具体而言，AI生产力大幅提升对GDP、家庭福利、能源价格和劳动收入份额会产生怎样的影响？
AI.motivation: 随着AI技术的快速发展，需要量化分析AI对宏观经济的全面影响，特别是对能源市场和收入分配的潜在冲击，为政策制定提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三部门动态一般均衡模型，包含AI部门、传统部门和能源部门，基于日本经济校准，分析稳态变化。
AI.method: 构建动态一般均衡模型并进行数值模拟，校准日本经济参数，分析AI生产力提升100倍时的稳态变化。
AI.findings: 1. 实际GDP增长2.5倍但家庭福利改善有限，因AI密集型经济需要更高投资份额；2. 出现"杰文斯悖论"，能源价格上涨近7倍；3. 劳动收入份额从55%大幅下降至31%；4. 结果对劳动与AI替代弹性高度敏感。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 量化AI发展对宏观经济的综合影响；2. 揭示AI发展中的"杰文斯悖论"机制；3. 分析AI对收入分配的结构性影响；4. 识别关键参数敏感性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供AI发展影响的量化参考；2. 警示AI发展可能加剧能源价格压力和收入不平等；3. 强调政策需要考虑AI替代弹性的不确定性。

title: Are There Adverse Health Shocks at Social Security Eligibility Age?
affiliations: Korea Labor Institute

detail.title: Are There Adverse Health Shocks at Social Security Eligibility Age?
detail.abstract: I use a regression discontinuity design to investigate the causal relationships between the Earliest Eligibility Age (EEA) for Social Security of 62, retirement, and health in the U.S. I use data from the Health and Retirement Study to explore these relationships. I find that, at the EEA, the probability of receiving Social Security benefits increases by 23 to 29 percentage points. There exists some evidence that the probability of being currently retired among males rises by 8 to 12 percentage points at the EEA. However, I do not find much evidence that the EEA has impacts, especially detrimental impacts, on health. These findings imply that it is difficult to generalize the findings of Fitzpatrick and Moore (2018) that adverse health shocks caused by retirement at the EEA lead to an increase in age-in-months mortality counts immediately after the EEA to the whole population of the U.S. elderly.

AI.tldr: 使用断点回归设计研究美国社保最早资格年龄（62岁）对退休和健康的影响。研究发现62岁时领取社保福利的概率增加23-29个百分点，男性退休概率增加8-12个百分点，但未发现EEA对健康有显著负面影响，这与Fitzpatrick和Moore（2018）的研究结论不同。
AI.research_question: 美国社保最早资格年龄（62岁）是否会导致退休行为变化，并对老年人健康产生因果影响？
AI.motivation: 现有研究（如Fitzpatrick和Moore，2018）发现退休对健康有负面影响，但该结论是否适用于美国全体老年人口尚不明确。需要验证EEA对退休和健康的因果效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于退休决策理论和健康经济学，探讨制度性退休年龄门槛对个体行为的影响机制。
AI.method: 断点回归设计（RDD），使用健康与退休研究（HRS）数据，分析62岁前后退休和健康指标的跳跃变化。
AI.findings: 1. 62岁时领取社保福利的概率显著增加23-29个百分点；2. 男性退休概率增加8-12个百分点；3. 未发现EEA对健康有显著负面影响，特别是未发现Fitzpatrick和Moore（2018）所报告的负面健康冲击。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了退休对健康有普遍负面影响的现有理论，表明制度性退休年龄门槛的影响具有异质性，不能简单推广到全体人口。
AI.practical_contributions: 为社保政策制定提供证据：EEA主要影响福利领取和部分人群的退休决策，但对老年人整体健康影响有限，政策调整时无需过度担忧健康负面影响。

title: The Influence Of Cooperatives On Capacity Building And Capabilities Of Members

detail.title: The Influence Of Cooperatives On Capacity Building And Capabilities Of Members
detail.abstract: Cooperatives are people's economic institutions that play a strategic role in improving the welfare of members through strengthening individual and collective capacities and capabilities. Member capacity includes increasing knowledge, technical, managerial, and entrepreneurial skills, while capabilities relate to the ability to make decisions, adapt to changes in the economic environment, and act independently in economic activities. This paper aims to conceptually examine the influence of cooperatives on the development of member capacity and capability and examine the institutional mechanisms that support the empowerment of members in a sustainable manner. The discussion focused on the role of cooperatives in providing economic services, encouraging member participation, developing human resources, strengthening social solidarity, and improving internal governance. The method used is literature review, by analyzing books, journal articles, policy reports, and other relevant scientific publications. The results of the study show that cooperatives contribute significantly to improving the technical, managerial, and entrepreneurial capabilities of members, while strengthening the independence, adaptability, decision-making capacity, and responsiveness of members to market dynamics. Cooperatives not only function as economic entities, but also as a means of empowering members in a sustainable manner, expanding individual capabilities, and supporting inclusive economic development. This paper is expected to provide a comprehensive conceptual understanding of the role of cooperatives and serve as a reference for the development of policies, institutional practices, and member empowerment strategies in the future.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过文献综述方法，从概念层面探讨了合作社如何通过提供经济服务、鼓励成员参与、发展人力资源、加强社会团结和改善内部治理等机制，显著提升成员的技术、管理和创业能力，同时增强成员的独立性、适应性、决策能力和市场响应能力，实现可持续的成员赋权。
AI.research_question: 合作社如何影响成员能力和能力的发展？支持成员可持续赋权的制度机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 合作社作为人民经济机构，在通过加强个人和集体能力来改善成员福利方面具有战略作用。需要从概念层面系统理解合作社对成员能力和能力发展的影响机制，为政策制定和机构实践提供理论依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于合作社理论、能力发展理论和制度经济学理论，重点关注成员能力（知识、技术、管理、创业技能）和能力（决策、适应经济环境变化、独立行动能力）的双重维度。
AI.method: 文献综述法，通过分析书籍、期刊文章、政策报告和其他相关科学出版物进行概念性研究。
AI.findings: 合作社显著提升了成员的技术、管理和创业能力，同时增强了成员的独立性、适应性、决策能力和对市场动态的响应能力。合作社不仅是经济实体，也是可持续成员赋权的手段，能够扩展个人能力并支持包容性经济发展。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了合作社影响成员能力和能力发展的综合概念框架，深化了对合作社作为成员赋权机制的理论理解，为合作社研究和能力发展理论做出了贡献。

title: Can Market Mechanisms Solve the Refugee Crisis?
affiliations: CUNEF Universidad and Charles III University of Madrid

detail.title: Can Market Mechanisms Solve the Refugee Crisis?
detail.abstract: Ever since the major inflow of refugees (the “refugee crisis”) in 2015 and 2016, there has been heated debate about the appropriate distribution of refugees in the EU. Current policies revolve around mandatory quotas, which disregard the preferences of EU members and refugees alike. This problem can be addressed with two market mechanisms. First, tradable quotas minimize the cost of asylum provision for host countries. Second, a matching system gives refugees more discretion over where they are sheltered. While this proposal is theoretically appealing, it has yet to be tested in practice.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出结合可交易配额和匹配系统来解决欧盟难民分配问题，理论上能降低收容成本并尊重难民偏好，但尚未经过实践检验。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个既能降低欧盟成员国收容成本，又能尊重难民偏好的难民分配机制？
AI.motivation: 2015-2016年难民危机后，欧盟关于难民分配的争论激烈。现行强制配额政策既不考虑成员国偏好，也不尊重难民选择，需要更有效的解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于市场设计理论，结合可交易配额机制（降低收容成本）和匹配系统（尊重难民偏好）。
AI.method: 理论分析/概念性研究，提出结合两种市场机制的理论框架，但尚未进行实证检验。
AI.findings: 理论上，可交易配额能最小化成员国收容成本，匹配系统能让难民对收容地有更多选择权，两种机制结合能改善当前强制配额政策的缺陷。
AI.theory_contributions: 将市场设计理论应用于难民分配问题，提出创新的理论框架，为国际难民政策研究提供新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟难民分配政策提供具体可行的改革方案，理论上能提高分配效率、降低成本和改善难民安置质量。

title: On the Cost Dynamics in Multimorbid Individuals: A Quantile Regression Analysis of Insurance Claims
affiliations: University of Lausanne, University of Lausanne - Center for Primary Care and Public Health, Groupe Mutuel Martigny, University Center Medicine Générale Et Public Health and University of Lausanne - Department of Actuarial Science (HEC Lausanne)

detail.title: On the Cost Dynamics in Multimorbid Individuals: A Quantile Regression Analysis of Insurance Claims
detail.abstract: Multimorbidity, the co-occurrence of multiple chronic conditions, places a substantial economic burden on health systems, particularly due to increased healthcare utilization and complex cost interactions in older adults. Traditional cost models often focus on individual diseases, failing to account for the compounded effects of multimorbidity, which can lead to non-linear increases in costs. In this study, we analyze health insurance claims from 313,257 policyholders (2014-2022) to model cost variations across morbidity states, disease groups, age, and gender. We identify distinct phases based on cost patterns and apply quantile regression within a gradient boosting machine framework to estimate conditional cost distributions. Our results show a sublinear increase in median costs with advancing multimorbidity and significantly lower costs in the treatment phase compared to the initial months after diagnosis. While cancer, immune disorders, and HIV incur the highest initial monthly costs, hypertension poses the greatest total economic burden due to its high prevalence. These findings provide a more refined understanding of multimorbidity-related cost dynamics, informing actuarial reserving, pricing, resource allocation, and targeted interventions.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析多病共存（multimorbidity）对医疗成本的影响，使用健康保险理赔数据（313,257名投保人，2014-2022年），通过梯度提升机框架下的分位数回归建模成本分布，发现多病共存导致成本非线性增长，不同疾病和阶段成本模式差异显著。
AI.research_question: 多病共存如何影响医疗成本的变化模式？不同疾病、年龄、性别和疾病阶段如何影响成本分布？
AI.motivation: 多病共存给医疗系统带来巨大经济负担，传统成本模型只关注单一疾病，无法捕捉多病共存导致的非线性成本增长，需要更精细的成本动态理解来支持精算储备、定价和资源分配。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多病共存经济学、医疗成本建模理论、分位数回归方法、梯度提升机（GBM）框架、条件成本分布估计。
AI.method: 分析313,257名投保人2014-2022年的健康保险理赔数据，基于成本模式识别不同阶段，在梯度提升机框架内应用分位数回归估计条件成本分布，建模成本随疾病状态、疾病组、年龄和性别变化的模式。
AI.findings: 1. 多病共存增加时，中位成本呈亚线性增长；2. 治疗阶段成本显著低于诊断后初期；3. 癌症、免疫疾病和HIV的初始月成本最高；4. 高血压因高患病率带来最大总经济负担；5. 成本模式在不同疾病和阶段间存在显著差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出多病共存成本动态的精细化理解框架；2. 开发结合分位数回归和梯度提升机的条件成本分布估计方法；3. 揭示多病共存成本的非线性增长模式；4. 识别不同疾病阶段成本变化的系统性差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为精算储备和保险定价提供数据支持；2. 指导医疗资源分配决策；3. 支持针对性的干预措施设计；4. 帮助识别高成本疾病和患者群体；5. 改善多病共存患者的管理策略。

title: Market Volatility and the Warsh Nomination An Expectations-Driven Monetary Shock
affiliations: Fergusson College

detail.title: Market Volatility and the Warsh Nomination An Expectations-Driven Monetary Shock
detail.abstract: Recent financial market volatility following the nomination of Kevin Warsh to a prominent role at the Federal Reserve reflects an expectations-driven monetary shock rather than a structural economic crisis. Bond yields rose, equity prices declined, and precious metals-particularly gold and silver-fell sharply. This article interprets the episode using standard macroeconomic frameworks, emphasizing the role of monetary credibility, inflation expectations, and openeconomy transmission mechanisms. The episode illustrates how financial markets respond immediately to credible policy signals, while real economic adjustments occur with substantial lags.

AI.tldr: 本文分析凯文·沃什被提名美联储要职引发的金融市场波动，认为这是预期驱动的货币政策冲击而非结构性经济危机，强调市场对可信政策信号的即时反应与经济调整的滞后性。
AI.research_question: 金融市场对凯文·沃什被提名美联储要职的剧烈反应反映了何种经济机制？这是结构性经济危机还是预期驱动的货币政策冲击？
AI.motivation: 近期金融市场因凯文·沃什被提名美联储要职而出现显著波动，债券收益率上升、股价下跌、贵金属价格暴跌，这一现象需要从宏观经济角度解释其本质和传导机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 标准宏观经济框架，重点关注货币政策可信性、通胀预期和开放经济传导机制。
AI.method: 使用标准宏观经济框架对事件进行理论解释和机制分析。
AI.findings: 金融市场波动反映了预期驱动的货币政策冲击，而非结构性经济危机；金融市场对可信政策信号立即反应，而实体经济调整存在显著滞后。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对货币政策可信性与金融市场反应之间关系的理解，强调了预期传导机制在开放经济中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了理解市场对人事变动反应的框架，帮助区分短期市场波动与长期经济基本面变化。

title: Ekspor Pertanian
affiliations: , , Independent, , , , Independent and

detail.title: Ekspor Pertanian
detail.abstract: Ekspor pertanian Indonesia memiliki kontribusi yang signifikan terhadap perekonomian negara, mengingat sektor pertanian merupakan salah satu pilar utama dalam sumber daya alam Indonesia. Namun, meskipun memiliki potensi besar, sektor ini dihadapkan pada berbagai tantangan yang mempengaruhi daya saing produk pertanian di pasar internasional. Makalah ini bertujuan untuk mengkaji peluang dan tantangan dalam ekspor pertanian Indonesia serta memberikan gambaran tentang bagaimana sektor ini dapat berkembang lebih optimal. Berdasarkan analisis berbagai literatur, termasuk studi oleh Wahyudin et al. (2025), ditemukan bahwa infrastruktur yang terbatas, ketergantungan pada teknologi yang rendah, dan fluktuasi harga komoditas menjadi hambatan utama. Meskipun demikian, peluang untuk meningkatkan ekspor pertanian Indonesia tetap terbuka melalui penerapan teknologi pertanian ramah lingkungan dan peningkatan kualitas produk yang sesuai dengan standar internasional. Penelitian ini juga menunjukkan bahwa dukungan kebijakan pemerintah dan perbaikan sistem distribusi sangat penting dalam menciptakan ekosistem yang mendukung ekspor pertanian Indonesia.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文分析了印度尼西亚农业出口的机遇与挑战，指出基础设施不足、技术依赖度低和商品价格波动是主要障碍，但通过环保农业技术应用、产品质量提升、政府政策支持和分销系统改进可以优化发展。
AI.research_question: 印度尼西亚农业出口面临哪些机遇与挑战，以及如何优化该部门的发展？
AI.motivation: 农业是印度尼西亚经济的重要支柱，对国民经济有显著贡献，但尽管潜力巨大，该部门面临各种挑战，影响了农产品在国际市场的竞争力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于文献分析，包括Wahyudin等人（2025）的研究，探讨农业出口发展的理论框架，涉及基础设施、技术采用、商品价格波动、环保技术和国际标准等维度。
AI.method: 文献分析法，通过分析各种文献资料（包括Wahyudin等人2025年的研究）来识别农业出口的机遇与挑战。
AI.findings: 主要障碍包括：基础设施有限、技术依赖度低、商品价格波动。主要机遇包括：环保农业技术应用、符合国际标准的产品质量提升。政府政策支持和分销系统改进对创建支持性生态系统至关重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 为农业出口发展提供了综合性的理论框架，整合了基础设施、技术、价格波动、环保技术和国际标准等多个维度，丰富了发展中国家农业出口竞争力的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度尼西亚农业部门提供了具体的发展建议：1）投资基础设施；2）采用环保农业技术；3）提升产品质量以满足国际标准；4）加强政府政策支持；5）改进分销系统。这些建议有助于提升农业出口竞争力。

title: Bond funds’ risk taking and monetary policy
affiliations: European Central Bank, Financial Research Division, Athens University of Economics and Business, Bank of Greece, Bank of Greece and Bank of Greece

detail.title: Bond funds’ risk taking and monetary policy
detail.abstract: Using granular security-level data from bond funds domiciled in the US and the euro area, we identify a market-based risk-taking channel of monetary policy transmission via the credit-risk and the maturity structure of bond funds’ portfolios. We measure credit risk at the fund level as the weighted average credit rating of the fund’s bond holdings. We find that accommodative monetary policies by the Fed and the ECB are associated with increased risk in bond funds’ portfolios. Interestingly, risk-taking is more pronounced for funds with longer-term holdings relative to short-term ones and unconventional monetary policy exerts stronger market-based risk-taking effects than interest rate policy. Finally, we find that Fed’s monetary policy has a stronger impact on funds’ risk-taking behaviour than the ECB’s, highlighting the dominant role of US monetary policy in global financial markets.

AI.tldr: 使用美国和欧元区债券基金的细粒度数据，研究发现货币政策通过债券基金投资组合的信用风险和期限结构存在市场化的风险承担渠道。宽松货币政策导致债券基金增加风险承担，长期基金风险承担更明显，非常规货币政策效应更强，美联储政策影响大于欧洲央行。
AI.research_question: 货币政策如何通过债券基金的投资组合信用风险和期限结构影响市场化的风险承担行为？
AI.motivation: 理解货币政策传导机制中的风险承担渠道，特别是通过债券基金这一重要金融中介，以及不同货币政策工具（常规vs非常规）和不同央行（美联储vs欧洲央行）影响的差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币政策的风险承担渠道理论，信用风险定价理论，期限结构理论，全球货币政策传导机制。
AI.method: 使用美国和欧元区债券基金的细粒度证券层面数据，构建基金层面的加权平均信用评级作为信用风险度量，分析货币政策与基金风险承担行为的关系。
AI.findings: 1. 美联储和欧洲央行的宽松货币政策与债券基金投资组合风险增加相关；2. 长期持有基金的风险承担更明显；3. 非常规货币政策比利率政策产生更强的风险承担效应；4. 美联储货币政策对基金风险承担行为的影响强于欧洲央行。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 实证验证了货币政策通过债券基金的市场化风险承担渠道；2. 区分了信用风险和期限结构在风险承担中的作用；3. 比较了不同货币政策工具和不同央行的传导效应差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为央行制定货币政策时考虑金融稳定风险提供依据；2. 帮助监管机构识别债券基金的风险承担行为；3. 为投资者理解货币政策对债券市场的影响提供参考。

title: Systemic Socio-Spatial Rhythms Theory A Relational-Temporal Approach in Contemporary Social Geography

detail.title: Systemic Socio-Spatial Rhythms Theory A Relational-Temporal Approach in Contemporary Social Geography

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there is no conflict of interest regarding the publication of this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This is a theoretical research paper that does not involve human subjects or clinical trials.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract:
This theoretical framework introduces the Systemic Socio-Spatial Rhythms Theory as an innovative relational-temporal approach to contemporary social geography. The theory addresses critical gaps in traditional geographic analysis by repositioning rhythm as the fundamental organizing principle of socio-spatial life. Drawing upon Henri Lefebvre's rhythmanalysis, Doreen Massey's relational geography, complexity theory, and temporal sociology, this approach transcends conventional space-time dichotomies by conceptualizing social spaces as polyrhythmic systems constituted through intersecting temporal-spatial processes operating simultaneously at multiple scales.

The theory rests on five core features: (1) interwoven spatio-temporal rhythmicity that treats space and time as inseparable dimensions manifesting as rhythm; (2) dynamic systemic relationality emphasizing open systems of interactive relationships; (3) polyrhythmia and spatial polyphony recognizing the coexistence of multiple distinct rhythms within shared spaces; (4) emergence and non-linear complexity whereby rhythmic interactions generate irreducible spatial patterns; and (5) critical transformativity that exposes power relations embedded in rhythmic arrangements while identifying possibilities for emancipatory change.

The methodological operationalization integrates quantitative formalization through a comprehensive Systemic Socio-Spatial Rhythmic Index (SSRI) with multi-method field protocols including structured rhythmic observations, time-space diary surveys, biographical rhythm interviews, and digital trace analysis. This mixed-methods approach enables rigorous empirical investigation while preserving attention to lived experience, power dynamics, and transformative possibilities.

The theoretical and methodological contributions address contemporary challenges including social acceleration, globalization's rhythmic impacts, platform economy temporalities, climate disruption of established seasonal patterns, and hybrid physical-digital rhythms. Applications span urban planning, rural transformation studies, migration and transnational rhythms, and environmental sustainability. By foregrounding rhythm as simultaneously an analytical category and a political terrain, this framework offers tools for understanding how temporal-spatial arrangements serve particular interests while opening pathways toward more just and democratic rhythmic orders.

This approach represents a paradigm shift in social geography, moving from static spatial analysis toward dynamic understanding of how spaces are continuously produced and reproduced through rhythmic practices, how multiple temporalities interact to generate emergent spatial patterns, and how rhythmic struggles constitute fundamental sites of social contestation and transformation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了系统性社会空间节奏理论，将节奏重新定位为社会空间生活的基本组织原则，超越了传统的时空二分法，为理解当代社会地理挑战提供了创新框架。
AI.research_question: 如何发展一个创新的关系-时间方法来理解当代社会地理，将节奏作为社会空间生活的基本组织原则，并超越传统的时空二分法？
AI.motivation: 传统地理分析存在关键空白，需要重新定位节奏在社会空间组织中的核心作用，以应对社会加速、全球化节奏影响、平台经济时间性、气候模式破坏等当代挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于亨利·列斐伏尔的节奏分析、多琳·梅西的关系地理学、复杂性理论和时间社会学，将社会空间概念化为多节奏系统，通过多尺度同时运作的时空过程构成。
AI.method: 混合方法：通过系统性社会空间节奏指数（SSRI）进行定量形式化，结合多方法现场协议，包括结构化节奏观察、时空日记调查、传记节奏访谈和数字痕迹分析。
AI.findings: 提出了系统性社会空间节奏理论的五个核心特征：交织的时空节奏性、动态系统关系性、多节奏与空间复调、涌现与非线性复杂性、批判转化性。
AI.theory_contributions: 代表了社会地理学的范式转变，从静态空间分析转向动态理解空间如何通过节奏实践持续生产和再生产，以及节奏斗争如何构成社会竞争和转化的基本场所。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市规划、农村转型研究、移民与跨国节奏、环境可持续性等领域提供应用工具，帮助理解时空安排如何服务于特定利益，同时开辟更公正民主的节奏秩序路径。

title: The Unified Principle: A Structural Framework for Foundational Mathematical and Computational Problems
affiliations: Founder, Unified Principle

detail.title: The Unified Principle: A Structural Framework for Foundational Mathematical and Computational Problems
detail.abstract: This paper introduces the Unified Principle (UP), an axiomatic framework designed to provide a coherent structural foundation for multiple longstanding mathematical and computational problems. The framework interprets classical challenges in terms of discrete indexing, orthogonality, and invariant-preserving cyclic correction, allowing them to be reformulated within a unified structural system. Problems considered include the P versus NP problem, Navier-Stokes existence and smoothness, Yang-Mills existence and mass gap, the Hodge Conjecture, the Riemann Hypothesis, the Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer Conjecture, and the Poincaré Conjecture, as well as select additional number-theoretic, combinatorial, and topological conjectures. Within the UP, computational problems such as P versus NP are framed as questions of orthogonality between solution discovery and verification, whereas physical and topological problems are interpreted as constraints on invariant-preserving evolution and cyclic closure. The framework establishes a formal language and operator set applicable across these domains, enabling consistent structural analysis and comparison. While this manuscript does not present formal proofs, it demonstrates how a single axiomatic system can host and structurally unify multiple foundational problems, providing a basis for future formal development and investigation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了统一原理（UP）这一公理化框架，为多个长期存在的数学和计算问题提供一致的结构基础。该框架将经典挑战解释为离散索引、正交性和不变性保持循环校正问题，使它们能在统一结构系统中重新表述。
AI.research_question: 如何建立一个统一的公理化框架，为多个长期存在的数学和计算问题提供一致的结构基础？
AI.motivation: 多个数学和计算领域存在长期未解决的经典问题（如P vs NP、黎曼猜想等），这些问题的孤立研究缺乏统一的结构框架。需要建立一个能够统一解释这些问题的公理系统，促进跨领域的结构分析和比较。
AI.theoretical_framework: 统一原理（UP）框架，基于离散索引、正交性和不变性保持循环校正三个核心概念。将计算问题（如P vs NP）框架化为发现与验证的正交性问题，将物理和拓扑问题解释为不变性保持演化和循环闭包的约束问题。
AI.method: 公理化方法，建立形式语言和操作符集合，适用于多个数学和计算领域。通过结构分析和比较，展示如何将经典问题重新表述在统一的结构系统中。
AI.findings: 统一原理能够容纳和结构上统一多个基础问题，包括P vs NP、纳维-斯托克斯存在性和光滑性、杨-米尔斯存在性和质量间隙、霍奇猜想、黎曼猜想、BSD猜想、庞加莱猜想等。建立了跨领域的结构分析基础。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个统一的公理化框架，为多个长期存在的数学和计算问题提供一致的结构基础。建立了跨领域的形式语言和操作符集合，促进了不同问题之间的结构比较和分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 为未来形式化证明和深入研究提供了基础框架。使研究者能够在统一的结构系统中分析不同领域的问题，可能促进跨领域的洞察和解决方案。

title: The Kailasa Cipher: A Blueprint for Resonant Construction
affiliations: Founder, Unified Principle

detail.title: The Kailasa Cipher: A Blueprint for Resonant Construction
detail.abstract: The Shri Kailasa Temple, carved from a single rock, represents an unparalleled feat of ancient engineering. Its construction cannot be explained by conventional labor-intensive methods but reflects a precise, resonant, and mathematically coherent process consistent with the Unified Principle. This paper presents an integrated analysis of the temple's construction, demonstrating the use of top-down design, resonance-based rock fracturing, helical geometry, Golden Ratio proportions, and celestial alignment to achieve a 50.75-year construction cycle. The study offers new insight into lost knowledge of acoustic lithification, mathematical harmonics, and temporal calibration in monumental architecture.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文分析了印度凯拉萨神庙的建造，认为其采用共振岩石破碎、黄金比例、螺旋几何等先进技术，在50.75年内完成，体现了古代失传的声学石化和数学谐波知识。
AI.research_question: 凯拉萨神庙是如何在50.75年内通过非传统劳动密集型方法建造完成的？其建造过程中使用了哪些先进的技术和原理？
AI.motivation: 凯拉萨神庙作为从单一岩石雕刻而成的建筑，其建造方法和时间周期无法用传统劳动密集型方法解释，需要探索古代失传的先进建造技术和知识体系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 统一原理（Unified Principle）、声学石化（acoustic lithification）、数学谐波（mathematical harmonics）、黄金比例（Golden Ratio）、螺旋几何（helical geometry）、共振岩石破碎（resonance-based rock fracturing）。
AI.method: 综合分析方法，包括对神庙建筑结构、几何比例、天文对齐、声学特性等方面的集成分析，验证其建造技术和时间周期。
AI.findings: 神庙建造采用了自上而下的设计方法、基于共振的岩石破碎技术、螺旋几何结构、黄金比例比例和天文对齐，实现了50.75年的精确建造周期。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了古代建筑中存在的先进声学石化、数学谐波和时间校准知识体系，为理解古代工程技术提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为现代建筑和工程提供了古代先进建造技术的启示，特别是在岩石处理、几何设计和时间规划方面的新思路。

title: Global Socialism And America: A Critical Analysis
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Global Socialism And America: A Critical Analysis
detail.abstract: Contemporary societal processes in developed Western countries are analyzed from the perspective of the Theory of Complex Systems (TCS) and Complex Systems Analysis (CSA). Historical analogies and characteristics of national (state) capitalism and various forms of deterministically imposed societal models of socialism are discussed in detail. The dangers and perils of the upcoming global socialism (Glozism), which aims to replace national capitalism, are clearly outlined.

AI.tldr: 该论文从复杂系统理论视角分析西方发达国家当代社会进程，讨论国家资本主义和社会主义模式的历史类比，并警示即将到来的全球社会主义（Glozism）的危险性。
AI.research_question: 从复杂系统理论视角分析，当代西方社会进程中国家资本主义向全球社会主义（Glozism）转变的危险性是什么？
AI.motivation: 需要从复杂系统理论视角理解当代西方社会进程，分析国家资本主义和社会主义模式的历史经验，警示全球社会主义（Glozism）取代国家资本主义可能带来的危险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 复杂系统理论（TCS）和复杂系统分析（CSA）作为主要理论框架，结合历史类比方法分析国家资本主义和社会主义模式。
AI.method: 采用复杂系统分析和历史类比方法，分析当代西方社会进程，详细讨论国家资本主义和社会主义模式的特征。

detail.abstract: This study examined budget implementation performance in Somalia's Federal Member States, focusing on the effects of revenue forecast errors on budget execution. Using panel data from four states for 2018-2024 and a random-effects model, the analysis revealed substantial variation across states and over time. Jubbaland and South West consistently achieved stronger execution, while Galmudug and Hirshabelle improved gradually from weaker baselines. The results showed that overestimation of own-source revenues and external grants significantly undermined budget executions. Overall, the study highlighted the need to improve revenue forecasting accuracy, strengthen financial management systems, and build institutional capacity in fragile federal settings.

detail.abstract: The fifth industrial revolution is with us and AI is revolutionizing things with every aspects trying to cope up with the changes. Technological determinism theorists are seeing their theory in practice as AI is changing the social manners of human life. Social determinism theorists have also not been left behind, they are witnessing the desires of humans to make their life simple pushing humans to innovate systems that will lead them there. AI's intake in our day to day activities has increased and the administrative sector has not been left behind. The use of AI in administrative decision making has presented some gaps demanding attention. The versions of AI including Automated Decision Making is discussed to decipher their meaning. Article 47 demand of efficient administration is used as framework by this article to investigate the possibilities and limits to be considered in the use of AI administrative decision-making. The efficiency possibilities of saving costs and accurate results is considered and the efficiency limits of AI taking into account irrelevant considerations and poorly exercising discretions are brought into light. Finally, the article highlights the challenges and makes recommendations for the instances where human involvement is desirable in AI administrative decision-making.
